use default

r_sequence() -> Pipe[int] is
    let skipped = LIST()
    let value mut = 1
    let n mut = 1

    yield value

    do
        let step =
            if skipped.count >= n then skipped[n - 1] else value + 1 fi

        for missing in (value + 1)..(value + step) do
            skipped.add(missing)
        od

        value = value + step
        n = n + 1

        yield value
    od
si

s_sequence() -> Pipe[int] is
    let in_r = r_sequence()

    assert in_r.move_next() else "the R sequence never runs out"

    for candidate in stream(1, n => n || n + 1) do
        if candidate == in_r.current then
            assert in_r.move_next() else "the R sequence never runs out"
        else
            yield candidate
        fi
    od
si

ffr(n: int) -> int =>
    r_sequence() |> skip(n - 1) |> first_or_throw()

ffs(n: int) -> int =>
    s_sequence() |> skip(n - 1) |> first_or_throw()

write_line("first ten of R: {(1::10) |> map(ffr) |> join(", ")}")
write_line("first ten of S: {(1::10) |> map(ffs) |> join(", ")}")

let covered = r_sequence()
    |> take(40)
    |> cat(s_sequence() |> take(960))
    |> sort()
    |> index(1)
    |> all(entry => entry.value == entry.index)

write_line("")
write_line(
    if covered then
        "the first 40 of R and first 960 of S are the integers"
        " 1 to 1000, each exactly once"
    else
        "the first 40 of R and first 960 of S do not cover 1 to 1000"
    fi)
